title: Ento-Linguistics: Language, Ambiguity, and Scientific Communication in Entomology
description: Ento-Linguistics v1.3.0 adds a receipted vocabulary and shared-document-threshold diagnostic, a graphical abstract and a synchronized 20-minute complex-systems research lecture. Architecture, Fertilization, Expansion supports questions about units, cross-disciplinary exchange and validated transfer. Six overlapping terminology domains and four separate source layers retain their descriptive scope. Fixed-margin comparisons and heuristic entropy/CACE measures remain distinct from biological interactions, validated meaning or causal reader effects. Paper figures are CC BY 4.0; software and authored narration are MIT; source corpus materials retain their providers terms. Previous version DOIs preserve earlier artifact identities.
